<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate initially, then mirror the opponent’s most recent action. This preserves mutual cooperation with cooperative opponents while responding immediately to defection, avoiding the permanently punitive behavior of the prior policy after a single isolated defection.
</DESCRIPTION>
